search_updates.claim: 2006 Criminal Law Act, up to 1 year, indecency exposure
search_updates.found: PARTIAL: penalty CONFIRMED up to 1 year imprisonment with fines; but MALE sodomy unlawful since 1891 (common law), the 2006 Criminal Law (Codification and Reform) Act codified it and extended criminalisation to FEMALES (indecent acts) — '2006 act criminalises sodomy' misattributes the male offence; 'actions perceived as homosexual' (holding hands etc.) criminalised. Gender change not allowed — supports the no-LGR claim.
